name: Cursor Marketplace
description: Cursor IDE's official depot for plugins and skills. Browse and install via Cursor: /add-plugin in chat or Settings → Rules. Open standard: agentskills.io.
install_hint: In Cursor: run /add-plugin in Agent chat and search, or install from GitHub via Settings → Rules → Add Rule → Remote Rule (Github). Skills go in .cursor/skills/ or ~/.cursor/skills/.

name: Antigravity Skills Directory
description: 2,384+ agentic skills for AI coding agents (Claude, Cursor, Gemini, Antigravity). Searchable by category: AI agents, coding, security, DevOps, etc.
install_hint: Browse and download skills; install to .cursor/skills/, ~/.claude/skills/, or Antigravity skill dir. Skill Manager (VS Code) extension supports batch install from GitHub.

name: Antigravity Skills (antigravityskills.org)
description: Curated directory: 245+ skills for Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and Google Antigravity. 10 categories including Coding, Data, Security, DevOps.
install_hint: Download or clone skill repos; copy to .cursor/skills/ or ~/.claude/skills/. Compatible SKILL.md format across agents.

name: Claude Skills (claudeskills.info)
description: Large curated collection: 158+ free, open-source skills (SKILL.md). Official and community. Download from skill pages.
install_hint: Open a skill and download or copy SKILL.md; place in ~/.claude/skills/<skill-id>/SKILL.md

name: SkillsMP
description: Agent Skills Marketplace: 530k+ open-source agent skills. Categories: dev, business, testing, DevOps.
install_hint: Browse by category; download or follow install instructions on each skill page.

name: ClawHub (OpenClaw)
description: Public skill registry for OpenClaw (npm for AI agents). 3k+ community skills. CLI install.
install_hint: Install OpenClaw CLI, then: clawhub search "..." ; clawhub install <skill-name>

name: Claude Plugins (claude-plugins.dev)
description: Community registry for Claude Code plugins. CLI: npx claude-plugins install.
install_hint: Use their CLI: npx claude-plugins install <name>

name: Claude Skill Registry (GitHub)
description: Daily-updated registry with web UI, CLI (sk), and JSON API.
install_hint: Browse or use CLI 'sk' for search/install. See repo: majiayu000/claude-skill-registry
